name: Hannah Arendt
role: German, Jewish, and American historian and philosopher
contribution: A German and American philosopher, political theorist, and public historian.

checks.lead: Hannah Arendt (born Johanna Arendt; 14 October 1906 – 4 December 1975) was a German and American philosopher, political theorist, and public historian. She was one of the most influential political theorists of the twentieth century.
